verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a cloud platform, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documentation of retention policies, data lifecycle rules, retention periods, or guaranteed data deletion. The only nearby item is CloudFormation stack deletion removing provisioned resources, which is resource lifecycle management, not a data retention or deletion control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
